summary: TuHURA Biosciences filed an 8-K to report entry into a $50 million revolving credit facility with Parkview Holdings One LLC, an affiliate of its largest stockholder. The facility matures April 2031, bears 12% interest (18% upon default), is secured by substantially all assets, and limits draws to the greater of $1.7M or monthly budgeted expenses. Proceeds fund operations and clinical trials into Q1 2028. The filing pertains to a routine debt financing, not a special situation event.
